svg.title: Four-Input Spreading Funnel in Stage 04 (SpanningTheorem.lean)
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical diagram of the Stage 04 four-input spreading funnel proving Theorem B across EqualMultiplicities.lean, Moments.lean, SpanningTheorem.lean, FewTranslates.lean, and ShortAndEnough.lean. The top layer presents three parallel analytic inputs: (1) Trace Comparison in EqualMultiplicities.lean (cobalt) transfers traces between the indefinite space Y_0 and definite twin W_m via a cuspidal primitive polynomial label c_x (trace_heckeOnGood_eq, targetDim_eq_finrank_goodForms_spaceW), yielding the target-dimension ceiling d_T <= #G_bar * deg * mass_r (targetDim_le_card_mul_besselDegree_mul_mass), with a cross-pillar rust badge noting that det_rallisOnGood_eq also feeds Stage 05 (05_determinant/norm_of_chain); (2) Whole-Group Second Moment in Moments.lean (amber) bounds the sum over s in G_bar of ||P* s P||_HS^2 by (1 + 9 b^-4) D_main (sum_hilbertSchmidtNorm_scaledPoincare_sq_le), where D_main = D_X^2 / (deg * mass_r); (3) Good Idempotent and Near-Isometry in SpanningTheorem.lean and Moments.lean (emerald) forms e_0 = e_{p_0} tensor e_{p_1} with bad share Re((1 - e_{p_i})(1)) <= b^-8 / 2 (bad_types_rare) and combines ||(1 - e_0) P||_HS^2 <= 4 b^-4 D_X with ||P* P - 1||_HS^2 <= b^-12 D_X to establish IsNearIsometry (e_0 P) (5 b^-4). In the middle layer (Cancellation and Welch-Style Spreading, FewTranslates.lean::isSpread_of_second_moment), multiplying Input 1 by Input 2 cancels deg * mass_r cleanly to give d_T * sum_{s in G_bar} ||P* s P||_HS^2 <= #G_bar * (1 + 9 b^-4) * D_X^2 (targetDim_mul_sum_hilbertSchmidtNorm_sq_le), nearly tight against the Welch floor #G_bar * D_X^2; pairing with Input 3 at uniform error eps_0 = (8 b^2)^-1 via Cauchy-Schwarz and AM-GM proves New.Data.isSpread_goodPoincare: for every target subspace F of share alpha = dim F / d_T, some translate s in G_bar satisfies dim (e_0 s P)^-1(F) <= ((1 + alpha + 3 eps_0) / 2) D_X. The bottom layer runs Wolsey greedy covering (IsSpread.exists_few_le_finrank_iSup_range), shrinking codimension by (1 - 2 D_X / (5 d_T)) per step down to 16 eps_0 = 2 / b^2, restricts to ramifiedSourceForms at an additional loss of at most 2 / b^2, and delivers Stage 01 Theorem B (D.enough_forms in ShortAndEnough.lean): a finite translate set t subset G_bar with #t * dim(src) <= 5 d_T log(1 + 2 b^2) spanning at least (1 - 4 / b^2) d_T dimensions, feeding 01_reduction/short_and_enough and 06_one_lift/gluing_maps.
